scripts.test: pnpm --filter @accountable-books/contracts build && pnpm run build && NODE_ENV=test vitest run
scripts.migrate:make: pnpm run knex migrate:make -x ts --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:local: pnpm run knex migrate:latest --env local --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:test: NODE_ENV=test pnpm run knex migrate:latest --env test --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate: pnpm run migrate:local && pnpm run bootstrap:local && NODE_ENV=test tsx scripts/setup-test-db.ts
scripts.migrate:staging: NODE_ENV=staging LOCAL_STAGING=true pnpm run knex migrate:latest --env staging --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.migrate:staging:remote: NODE_ENV=staging pnpm run knex migrate:latest --env staging --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.rollback:local: pnpm run knex migrate:rollback --env local --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.rollback:test: NODE_ENV=test pnpm run knex migrate:rollback --all --env test --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.rollback: pnpm run rollback:local && pnpm run rollback:test
scripts.rollback:staging: NODE_ENV=staging LOCAL_STAGING=true pnpm run knex migrate:rollback --env staging --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.rollback:staging:remote: NODE_ENV=staging pnpm run knex migrate:rollback --env staging --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run bootstrap:local && pnpm run bootstrap:test
scripts.bootstrap:platform: pnpm run bootstrap:platform:local && pnpm run bootstrap:platform:test
scripts.seed:system-firms: pnpm run seed:system-firms:local && pnpm run seed:system-firms:test
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run db:reset:local && pnpm run db:reset:test && pnpm run migrate && pnpm run demo:apply
scripts.demo:apply: pnpm run demo:apply:local && pnpm run demo:apply:test
scripts.demo:apply:staging:local: NODE_ENV=staging LOCAL_STAGING=true pnpm run demo apply
scripts.demo:apply:no-transactions:test: NODE_ENV=test pnpm run demo apply --exclude bank-transactions
scripts.demo:apply:basic: pnpm run demo:apply:no-transactions && pnpm run demo:apply:no-transactions:test
scripts.demo:reverse: pnpm run demo:reverse:local && pnpm run demo:reverse:test
scripts.demo:reset: pnpm run demo:reset:local && pnpm run demo:reset:test
scripts.demo:status: pnpm run demo:status:local && pnpm run demo:status:test
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli releases files "$SENTRY_RELEASE" upload-sourcemaps dist --rewrite && sentry-cli releases finalize "$SENTRY_RELEASE"
